sections.heading: 1. Wrist curl
lines: ① Palm up, forearm resting on your thigh.
② Curl a light dumbbell up and down slowly.
③ 3 sets of 10–15, every second day.
④ Mild ache gone by tomorrow? Usually OK.

slides.title: Still aching after easing off?
slides.bubble:

An assessment comes first!
slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Inside of your elbow aching every time you grip, lift or pull? Lulu has never swung a golf club, and he still got golfer's elbow.

Heavy pulling at the gym, tools all day, carrying shopping and long hours on a mouse can all add up on the tendons that bend your wrist.

Full rest often calms it, but the tendon usually needs gradual loading to build capacity again. Try slow wrist curls with a light dumbbell, 3 sets of 10–15 every second day, and lighten your grip where you can.

Tingling into the ring and little fingers, or pain that keeps building, is worth getting checked. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 💪
